title: Projection Obstruction for Factorized States: Nonlinear Dynamics, Conditional ℓ1 Diagnostics, and Exact Short-Time Defect Bounds
description:
For finite one- and two-local quantum dynamics starting from a product state, the raw pair-defect bound is D_e(t) >= nu_e t - 24 g^2 t^2, with the full incident interaction norm g. Written proofs establish local derivative and cumulant onset bounds, tangent approximation formulas, and conditional observer and reconstruction results. The publication is presented as a unified 69-page edition with explicit assumptions.

Edition 6.9.18 reconciles cut material with archived revisions and sibling packages, corrects tangent and unbounded-generator domains, distinguishes the sharp marginal derivative norm 2 from residual bound 3, and corrects the topology, perturbation and noise examples. Infinite-volume conclusions require a uniform incident interaction bound. Selected Lean formalizations, exact finite checks, numerical diagnostics and historical reproduction records retain separate scopes. Sampled numerical estimates are not validated continuous-time enclosures.
